body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #497, 2026-10-09 17:28Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg directs: do not run synthetic CPU-saturation / busy-loop diagnostics on the shared machine. For host/control failures, prioritize observable diagnostics: the UI card must show the actionable structured refusal/error cause and relevant operation/correlation where available, rather than only a generic control_unavailable label. Preserve bounded logs/evidence sufficient to diagnose the next occurrence. Please record the scoped items and route routine implementation to coders; architects only for a real architecture decision."
Context: at 16:59-17:00Z a busy-loop diagnostic I approved starved the host API (w-e19cc72d5c89). Session-11323's "Waiting/Unknown" card showed only control_unavailable, although the cause was "named-root acknowledgement belongs to a superseded authority image" (w-b21c5132848c). The host keeps no record of a Resume click.
